Seer.directive_rationale: Keep forcing immediate claims to strip wolves of their blending time.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Jin immediately claimed Seer, revealed his check on Nhan, and commanded everyone else to claim their roles immediately, stating that hesitation would be treated as a wolf signal.
Seer.verdict_notes: Jin strictly followed the directive to force immediate claims during the first debate.

Seer.directive_rationale: ensure the Seer has a secondary check before exiling based solely on timing
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Cong and Nam delayed their claims. In the subsequent night (Round 2), Jin used his investigation on Cong.
Seer.verdict_notes: Jin targeted one of the players who delayed claiming (Cong) for his next night check before any of the delayers were exiled.

Guard.directive_rationale: Continue prioritizing the Seer, as their survival is the village's only objective source of truth.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: After Jin identified himself as the Seer in Round 1, Hoang chose to protect Jin during the night of Round 2.
Guard.verdict_notes: Hoang protected the identified Seer in Round 2.

Witch.directive_rationale: Never use the poison potion on a confirmed Trust Anchor
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nhan used the poison potion on Hoang. Hoang had not been cleared by the Seer; in fact, Jin had voted to exile Hoang in Round 1.
Witch.verdict_notes: The trigger requires the target to be Seer-cleared. Hoang was not cleared; therefore, the directive to withhold poison did not trigger.

Witch.directive_rationale: coordinate your poison targets strictly with the Seer's results
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nhan poisoned Hoang. Jin (the Seer) had previously voted against Hoang in Round 1, viewing him as a liar.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nhan's target (Hoang) was aligned with the Seer's previous identification of Hoang as a liar.

Witch.directive_rationale: use it only on high-probability wolf targets identified through behavioral deflection
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nhan poisoned Hoang after accusing him of lying and fabricating a power role in Round 1.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nhan identified Hoang's claim as a fabrication and used the poison on him.

Villager.directive_rationale: When a Seer identifies 'Compliance Simulation' (echoing the group without logic), trust that signal over the suspect's claims
Villager.verdict_notes: The Seer (Jin) never specifically identified 'Compliance Simulation' as the reason for his accusations; he cited attacking cleared players and misappropriating authority.
